rules.accepted_credit_types: Nursing CE approved by an ANCC-accredited credentialing agency (incl. ANCC-approved employer courses); online courses accepted; course types per N.J.A.C. 13:37-5.3(d).
rules.carryover: Up to 15 extra contact hours may be carried into the next renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Board may request certificates (random audit or investigation); keep certificates at least 5 years.

topics.who: all RNs and LPNs: prescription opioids, non-opioid pain alternatives, signs of abuse, addiction and diversion

rules.notes: CE window ends May 31 of the renewal year (Board example: renewal May 2019 covers June 1, 2017 - May 31, 2019). Retired/out-of-state nurses with active licenses must comply; inactive status needs no CE. Optional menopause CE counts (P.L. 2025, c. 175).
rules.rule_quote: Each licensee must complete a minimum of 30 contact hours of continuing education contact hours during the two-year period preceding renewal.
